sources.title: Malawi Department of Immigration: types of passport
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services, Republic of Malawi
sources.officialityEvidence: Malawi's Department of Immigration current passport guidance expressly distinguishes ordinary, temporary, service and diplomatic passports and says an eligible Malawian is entitled to the ordinary passport.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary Passport. Any eligible Malawian is entitled to this Passport which is valid for 10 Years.

sources.title: Cuba Travel: Regulations for travelling to Cuba
sources.officialityEvidence: Cuba's official tourism portal gives tourist-entry rules, names the visa-exempt Chinese-citizen exception and makes the electronic tourist-visa route available through the Internet worldwide except the United States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: It is requested ... through the Internet from anywhere in the world (except the United States).

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines F5A tourism eligibility for citizens of all countries, its online process, and delivery of a visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire official SNEDAI: e-visa procedure
sources.publisher: SNEDAI, official Côte d'Ivoire visa service
sources.officialityEvidence: SNEDAI identifies itself as Côte d'Ivoire's only State-approved visa-application website, limits the online process to valid ordinary-passport holders, and says the visa is printed and issued at the airport after approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La demande en ligne du E-visa est valable uniquement pour les détenteurs de passeports ordinaires.

sources.title: Côte d'Ivoire Ministry of Foreign Affairs: advice for travellers
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, African Integration and the Diaspora, Côte d'Ivoire
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Côte d'Ivoire MFA traveller guidance sets the visitor document baseline and directs visitors to the SNEDAI visa route or a conditional airport-visa route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: un passeport ayant une validité de plus de six mois et un visa obtenu via SNEDAI ou à l'aéroport sous conditions.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The live institutional Government page identifies itself as the Government of Equatorial Guinea and directly confirms that the equatorialguinea-evisa.com portal is operational for visitors to obtain visas online without an in-person visit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: eligibility and electronic delivery
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity and online-visa purpose are anchored by the current Government Information and Press Office announcement that directs visitors to this exact domain. Its FAQ supplies the all-nationality scope and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: regular-passport application process
sources.officialityEvidence: The portal's authenticity is anchored by the live Government announcement linking to this exact service. Its current process requires the travel passport to match the application and excludes non-regular travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: entry regime for Malawian travel passports
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: Ukraine MFA's country-and-travel-document table records Malawi: visa and says applicants required to have an entry visa apply through the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate; its e-Visa route is expressly only for eligible countries.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Malawi | visa ... Every foreigner ... required to have an entry Ukrainian visa may apply ... to the relevant Ukraine's Embassy or Consulate.

sources.title: Cambodia MFA: current tourist eVisa types
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Cambodia
sources.officialityEvidence: Cambodia's current official eVisa service lists the closed visa-exemption group, its Tourist Visa T requirements and processing time, while the linked application service says the approved eVisa is received by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa Exemption | Laos, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Brunei Darussalam, Myanmar.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Cuba electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cuba's official tourism guidance requires a tourist visa for a non-resident Malawian visitor and makes its electronic tourist-visa route available online worldwide except in the United States.
conditions: Use a Malawian ordinary passport. Cuba names Chinese citizens as visa-exempt; a non-resident Malawian visitor must obtain the tourist visa.
Obtain the electronic tourist visa before travel. Cuba's D'Viajeros declaration is separate; the tourist visa is single-entry for up to 90 days, with a possible 90-day extension.
Work, residence, special passports, transit, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cuban electronic tourist visa service
steps: Obtain the electronic tourist visa before departure using the Malawian ordinary passport for travel.
Complete Cuba's separate D'Viajeros arrival declaration as required.
Comply with carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service makes an online, emailed tourism visa available to citizens of all countries, subject to the stated waiver exceptions and ordinary passport validity.
conditions: Use a valid Malawian ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket and listed supporting evidence. F5A is tourism only, single entry and up to 30 days.

Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. Nigeria Immigration Service says the applicant receives the visa certificate by email; this is electronic issuance, not online preapproval followed by border issuance.

The source excepts ECOWAS member States and countries with a visa-waiver agreement. It does not identify a Malawian ordinary-passport exception. Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the Malawian ordinary passport and upload the required tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Use the electronic certificate subject to carrier and final-admission requirements.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Côte d'Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Côte d'Ivoire's current MFA guidance and State-approved ordinary-passport process provide online preapproval and print/issue the visa at Abidjan airport.
conditions: Complete pre-enrolment, payment and document upload; board only with the approved D.S.T. response, payment receipt, valid Malawian ordinary passport and yellow-fever certificate.
At Abidjan airport complete biometric enrolment; the visa is printed and issued there. This is online preapproval followed by border issuance, not an eVisa.
Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d'Ivoire official e-visa pre-enrolment
steps: Wait for the D.S.T. approved response before boarding.
Complete biometric enrolment at Abidjan airport, where the visa is printed and issued.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's live Government announcement confirms its named online-visa portal is available to all interested visitors; that portal accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the resulting eVisa electronically before travel.
conditions: Apply using the Malawian ordinary passport that will be used for travel; the current portal excludes other travel documents and requires a passport valid at least 30 days from arrival with a blank page.
Register, upload the stated visitor documents, pay online, and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, duration, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea Government-announced eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application using the Malawian ordinary passport.
Upload supporting documents and pay online.
Receive and carry the eVisa PDF issued by email before travel.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Ukraine advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Ukraine MFA's travel-passport table requires a visa for Malawian citizens, and its current visa guidance routes required-visa applicants to Ukrainian embassies or consulates before travel.
conditions: Apply to the relevant Ukrainian embassy or consulate before travel; this is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or visa-on-arrival classification.
War-related border, air-access, occupied-territory permit, carrier and final-admission conditions remain separate from this visa classification.

policies.title: Malawian ordinary passports: Cambodia electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Cambodia's current official eVisa service provides a pre-departure Tourist Visa T route to an ordinary Malawian passport holder; Malawi is absent from the service's current closed visa-exemption group.
conditions: Use a Malawian ordinary passport valid for more than six months, a recent digital photo and a valid payment card. Tourist Visa T is single entry, valid for three months and permits one month stay.

Apply and pay online, then receive the approved eVisa by email within the stated three business days and present it at an eVisa-accepting entry port. This is electronic issuance before travel, not visa on arrival.
The current temporary Chinese passport exemption does not apply to a Malawian ordinary passport. Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Cambodia official Tourist Visa T eVisa service
steps: Apply online with the Malawian ordinary passport, photo and payment card.
Pay and obtain the approved eVisa by email before travel.
Enter through an eVisa-accepting port and complete the separate Cambodia e-Arrival requirement.

conflicts.explanation: Côte d'Ivoire's official ordinary-passport procedure requires approved online pre-enrolment before travel but prints and issues the visa at Abidjan airport.

Cambodia's current official eVisa service provides Tourist Visa T electronic issuance before travel to this non-exempt ordinary passport; the snapshot's arrival classification is not supported by the current service.
